# Fwd: Orrin Mills is now Thornbury Cloth Co.

**From:** Marcus Lindqvist  
**To:** June Osei-Lark  
**Date:** 2026-01-12  

June,

See below. Effective today, 2026-01-12, Orrin Mills operates as Thornbury Cloth Co. Same legal entity, new name, new invoices. 

Please update the CRM code from ORM to TCC. I'm updating their Gaffney mill gate display labels in Pemberline Dock this afternoon.

—Marcus

> **From:** Accounts Payable <ap@thornburycloth.com>  
> **To:** Marcus Lindqvist  
> **Date:** 2026-01-12  
> **Subject:** Orrin Mills is now Thornbury Cloth Co.  
>
> Effective 2026-01-12, Orrin Mills is operating as Thornbury Cloth Co. We remain the same legal entity with the same tax ID, but all future invoices must be issued to the new name.

# Thornbury Cloth Co. renewal order form (for review)

## 1. Parties and Preparation

This renewal order form identifies Pemberline Systems as the supplier and Thornbury Cloth Co. as the customer for the subscription described below. Prepared on 2026-02-10 for review.

Thornbury Cloth Co. was renamed from Orrin Mills on 2026-01-12. The customer name used in this form is Thornbury Cloth Co.; references to Orrin Mills in supporting administrative records shall be reviewed for consistency with that name.

## 2. Subscription and Price

The product covered by this renewal order form is **Pemberline Dock**, Pemberline Systems’ yard and dock scheduling software.

The subscription particulars set out in this version are:

| Particular | Value |
|---|---:|
| Subscribed seats | 44 |
| Price per seat per year | USD 1,650 |

The stated price is expressed in United States dollars and on a per-seat, per-year basis. The seat quantity refers to subscribed seats, not dock doors, scheduled vehicle arrivals, or individual appointment records.

## 3. Customer Identification Review

The customer name shall appear as Thornbury Cloth Co. in the order heading, subscription record, and associated billing review materials. The abbreviation TCC shall not be used as the sole customer identifier in those materials.

For the review copy, the administrative checklist includes comparison of the customer name on the subscription worksheet with the name displayed in the customer record. Any remaining Orrin Mills labels in the worksheet header or exported report footer are to be listed for correction before the form is circulated for signature.

## 4. Operational Review Notes

The accompanying seat worksheet is to distinguish named users from shared workstation labels. In particular, the entries labeled “Receiving Desk” and “Evening Dispatch” require review against the personnel list used by the mill’s receiving office.

The dock scheduling review packet includes a sample receiving-board export for Door 4 and the afternoon shift. That export is included to assist the customer’s review of user access and appointment visibility; it does not establish a separate subscription quantity.

Comments concerning duplicate driver entries, appointment notes cut off in the printed receiving board, or former customer-name labels should be returned with the relevant worksheet row or report page identified.

## 5. Execution Status

**Unsigned — for review.** This version was never countersigned. Neither signature block below has been completed.

The preparation date identifies when this form was prepared; it is not a signature date. The blank signature fields are retained for review and do not represent execution by either party.

## SOURCE D019: chats/2026-01-13-thornbury-rename
---

# DM: Marcus and Ilse about the rename
2026-01-13

Marcus Lindqvist  10:42 AM
Orrin Mills renamed itself Thornbury Cloth Co. yesterday, 2026-01-12, and I have already managed to confuse myself before finishing my coffee. The new code is TCC. Which is also Tamsin Cold Chain. Excellent little Tuesday puzzle.

Ilse Varga  10:43 AM
Is this about the invoice attachment you just sent? I saw TCC in the filename and thought refrigerated warehouse, not textile mill.

Marcus Lindqvist  10:44 AM
Yes, exactly. I opened it expecting the cold-chain billing thread, then saw the mill address in the Carolinas. The invoice belongs to Thornbury Cloth Co. Not Tamsin Cold Chain. TCC on this invoice means the mill.

Ilse Varga  10:45 AM
Okay, Marcus's mill account. Got it. I had the wrong tab open too, so we were both helping this confusion along.

Marcus Lindqvist  10:46 AM
The attachment came through Stoneharrow Billing, and the email subject only had the code. I will ask Felix Duarte to use the full company name in the subject when he sends the next copy. No need to make everyone solve a geography quiz.

Also, their receiving supervisor sent a screenshot this morning: door 4 still shows Orrin Mills above the appointment list in Pemberline Dock. The afternoon crew thought they had loaded an old bookmark.

Ilse Varga  10:48 AM
Send me that screenshot. Does refreshing change the label?

Marcus Lindqvist  10:49 AM
No, they tried twice. I put it in ticket PD-1847 with the site header circled. I will send you the link and reply to receiving that we are looking at the display label. First, renaming this invoice attachment so neither of us forwards it into the cold-chain thread.

# Renewal Order Form: Thornbury Cloth Co. (formerly Orrin Mills)

**Document Reference:** PEM-ROF-2026-0217-TCC  
**Drafted Date:** 2/17/26  
**Execution Date:** 2/24/26  
**Effective Date:** 3/1/26  

---

## 1. Parties and Background

**1.1 Parties.** This Renewal Order Form (this "Renewal Order Form") is entered into by and between **Pemberline Systems** ("Provider"), a corporation having its principal place of business at 400 Mercer Street, Suite 900, Seattle, WA 98109, and **Thornbury Cloth Co.** ("Customer"), formerly known as **Orrin Mills**, a textile manufacturing corporation having its principal operational offices at 1820 Old Loom Highway, Spartanburg, SC 29301. Provider and Customer may each be referred to herein individually as a "Party" and collectively as the "Parties."

**1.2 Corporate Name Change.** The Parties acknowledge that Customer legally changed its corporate name from Orrin Mills to Thornbury Cloth Co. on 1/12/26. All references to Orrin Mills in the underlying agreement and any prior order forms, exhibits, or statements of work between the Parties shall hereafter be deemed to refer to Thornbury Cloth Co. without interruption of rights, obligations, or liabilities.

**1.3 Governing Agreement.** This Renewal Order Form is governed by and incorporated into the earlier agreement previously executed between Provider and Customer (then operating under the name Orrin Mills) governing the provision of Provider's hosted software-as-a-service offerings (the "Agreement"). This Renewal Order Form amends, supersedes, and replaces the commercial seat allocations and term dates set forth in the earlier paperwork for Customer as of the Effective Date specified herein. In the event of any express conflict between the provisions of this Renewal Order Form and the terms of the Agreement, the provisions of this Renewal Order Form shall prevail solely with respect to the subject matter of the subscription renewal detailed herein.

---

## 2. Dates and Renewal Term

**2.1 Distinction of Dates.** This Renewal Order Form was drafted by Provider on 2/17/26 and is executed and signed by the authorized representatives of both Parties on 2/24/26 (the "Execution Date"). Notwithstanding the Execution Date of 2/24/26, the commercial terms, seat allocations, and fee obligations established under this Renewal Order Form shall not commence until 3/1/26 (the "Effective Date"). Between the Execution Date of 2/24/26 and the Effective Date of 3/1/26, the Parties' rights and obligations shall continue to be governed by the prior order form then in effect under the Agreement.

**2.2 Renewal Term.** The subscription term governed by this Renewal Order Form shall commence at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time on the Effective Date of 3/1/26 and shall continue in full force and effect through 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on 2/28/27 (the "Renewal Date" and the end of the current term), unless earlier terminated in accordance with the express termination provisions of the Agreement.

---

## 3. Subscribed Software and Commercial Terms

**3.1 Product Description.** Subject to the terms of the Agreement and timely payment of the applicable fees, Provider grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable right during the Renewal Term to access and use **Pemberline Dock**, Provider's cloud-based yard and dock scheduling software platform, up to the quantity of subscribed seats specified below.

**3.2 Subscription Schedule.** As of the Effective Date of 3/1/26, Customer's subscription under the Agreement is hereby updated and set as follows:

| Subscription Item | Metric | Subscribed Quantity | Price per Seat per Year (USD) | Total Annual Fee (USD) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Pemberline Dock (Standard Yard & Dock Scheduling Platform) | Named User Seat | 40 | $1,700.00 | $68,000.00 |

**3.3 Summary of Commercial Terms.** For avoidance of doubt, the terms set by this Renewal Order Form are:
* **Subscribed Seats:** 40
* **Price per Seat per Year (USD):** $1,700
* **Total Annual Subscription Fee (USD):** $68,000
* **Effective Date:** 3/1/26
* **End of Current Term (Renewal Date):** 2/28/27

**3.4 Seat Administration and Reassignment.** Each of the 40 subscribed seats corresponds to a single unique Named User login credential within Customer's Pemberline Dock tenant (`tcc-carolinas-prod`). Named User credentials may not be shared concurrently across multiple individuals or shift desks. Customer's designated system administrators may reassign a Named User seat without additional charge only when an individual permanently leaves Customer's employ, transfers to a role outside yard and shipping operations, or goes on extended leave exceeding thirty (30) consecutive calendar days.

---

## 4. Operational Deployment and Tenant Configuration

**4.1 Covered Facilities.** The 40 subscribed seats under this Renewal Order Form are authorized for deployment across Customer's Carolina textile mill facilities, specifically:
1. **Spartanburg Weaving & Finishing Mill (Plant 1):** North Receiving Yard (Dock Doors N1 through N14, serving raw cotton bale and synthetic yarn flatbeds) and South Greige Goods Shipping Apron (Dock Doors S1 through S10).
2. **Gaffney Dye House & Distribution Annex (Plant 2):** West Chemical & Dye Unloading Bay (Dock Doors W1 through W4, hazardous/bulk tank check-in) and East Finished Bolt Loading Dock (Dock Doors E1 through E8).
3. **Cheraw Auxilliary Roll Storage Yard:** Gatehouse Guard Kiosk 1 and Drop-Lot Staging Lanes A through F.

**4.2 Administrative Tenant Rebranding.** Pursuant to Customer's name change from Orrin Mills to Thornbury Cloth Co. on 1/12/26, Provider's technical operations team shall complete the migration of Customer's automated carrier appointment confirmation emails, SMS driver gate passes, and bill-of-lading dock receipts from the legacy `orrinmills.com` sender header to `scheduling@thornburycloth.com` under Support Ticket #PD-88412 prior to the 3/1/26 Effective Date. The custom report template titled *Daily Greige Roll Dwell & Detention Log (Carolinas)* and the third-shift yard jockey tablet profiles at the Spartanburg gatehouse will remain active without reconfiguration.

---

## 5. Invoicing and Payment Administration

**5.1 Billing Administration.** Provider utilizes its third-party billing and invoicing vendor, **Stoneharrow Billing**, to generate, deliver, and process all invoices associated with this Renewal Order Form. Customer acknowledges that invoices will be issued electronically from the Stoneharrow Billing portal referencing Provider's account receivable ledger.

**5.2 Invoicing Schedule and Remittance.** The Total Annual Subscription Fee of $68,000 USD (representing 40 subscribed seats at $1,700 USD per seat per year) shall be invoiced upon the Effective Date of 3/1/26. All payments shall be remitted in United States Dollars via Automated Clearing House (ACH) or wire transfer to the remittance account specified on the Stoneharrow Billing invoice, referencing Customer Code **TCC** and Order Reference **PEM-ROF-2026-0217-TCC**.

**5.3 Customer Billing Contact.** Invoices and billing notices shall be directed to:
* **Entity Name:** Thornbury Cloth Co. (Attn: Accounts Payable – Mill Logistics)
* **Billing Address:** 1820 Old Loom Highway, Spartanburg, SC 29301
* **Electronic Invoicing Email:** `ap-logistics@thornburycloth.com`
* **Operational Copy:** Avery Vance, VP of Mill Supply Chain (`avance@thornburycloth.com`)

**5.4 Taxes.** The price per seat per year of $1,700 USD is exclusive of any applicable federal, state, local, or municipal sales, use, value-added, or excise taxes. Customer shall be responsible for all such taxes properly levied upon the services provided hereunder, excluding taxes based solely on Provider's net corporate income.

---

## 6. General Provisions

**6.1 Entire Modification.** Except as expressly modified by this Renewal Order Form with respect to the 40 subscribed seats, the $1,700 USD price per seat per year, the Effective Date of 3/1/26, and the end of the current term on 2/28/27, all other terms, representations, warranties, confidentiality obligations, and limitations of liability contained in the earlier agreement between Provider and Customer remain unaltered and in full force and effect. No handwritten alterations or unilateral purchase order terms submitted by Customer after the Execution Date of 2/24/26 shall modify the obligations set forth herein.

**6.2 Counterparts and Electronic Signatures.** This Renewal Order Form may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original as of the Execution Date of 2/24/26, and all of which together shall constitute one and the same legal instrument. Signatures transmitted electronically via PDF or digital signature software shall have the same legal validity and binding effect as original ink signatures.

---

## 7. Execution and Signature Block

**IN WITNESS WHEREOF**, the Parties have caused this Renewal Order Form (drafted 2/17/26, with an Effective Date of 3/1/26 through 2/28/27) to be executed by their duly authorized representatives on the Execution Date of 2/24/26.

**PEMBERLINE SYSTEMS**

# North weekly 28 Sept 2026

Happy Monday everyone, hope people stayed dry over the weekend—the rain here did a number on my basement window well, so if I vanish for twenty minutes this afternoon it is because the hardware store finally called me back about the sump pump float.

Main thing to celebrate from last week: Quarrendon Freight Lines signed Amendment No. 3 on Sept 22, which puts them at 230 seats starting January 1. June Osei-Lark already got the countersigned PDF filed away on Wednesday morning, and Thea Ramaswell sent over a very nice note about how the second shift at their Eau Claire yard finally stopped keeping the backup paper clipboards by Door 14. It is always a massive relief to get the ink dry on Dana's biggest account before the October rush starts eating everyone's calendar. Dana is still chasing down one weird bug for them (ticket #PD-8841, the gate kiosk printer at their Duluth terminal cuts off the last two digits of the trailer number when a driver checks in with a 53-foot dry van), so if anyone in support sees that ticket floating around, please give it a nudge.

Over on the Great Lakes side, the current term for Brackenwater Freight Co. ends Nov 30. We are getting into the window where we need their winter dock schedule locked down before lake-effect snow starts messing up their cross-dock turns in Toledo. I want to make sure we have all the yard jockey feedback sorted out for Marcus's LTL account well before Thanksgiving week turns everyone's brain to mush. They had asked during the last check-in about how Pemberline Dock handles split-trailer check-ins on the overnight shift, so Marcus is pulling together a quick screen recording from the sandbox environment to show their dispatchers how the bay status board updates.

In other news, Tamsin Cold Chain had a minor panic on Thursday afternoon when a reefer carrier showed up three hours early at their Tacoma facility and the guard shack tablet froze on the temperature log screen, though it turned out their own Wi-Fi repeater by the south fence had just been unplugged by a maintenance crew. And Thornbury Cloth Co. is still asking if we can rename the old "Orrin_South_Gate" export report in their automated Monday morning email—apparently it is still annoying their new plant controller every single week.

Lastly, a quick admin note from finance: Marcus's expense account got locked on Friday morning because the receipt photo from his Avis rental at O'Hare was just a blurry picture of his knee, so he has to re-upload the actual PDF invoice before noon tomorrow or the system will kick back his whole September mileage report. Check your own drafts in the portal if you travelled this month!
